records.title: Ad high CPU

model_decision.summary: ad-service is reporting health NOT_SERVING while CPU is elevated: health probe window shows cpu_utilization ~1.16 cores and the 60s metric window shows ~2.55 cores, with request rate very low (~0.03 rps) and error_rate 0.0. GetAds traces (22 spans, 11 traces) are all status OK with no error spans, and latencies are mostly single-digit to ~90 ms, so this is not an application-error or downstream-fa

proposed_action.rationale: High CPU (~2.55 cores at ~0.03 rps) with health NOT_SERVING and zero error spans on GetAds points to a CPU-burn path rather than traffic or downstream failure. The runbook associates this signature with the adHighCpu flag. Disabling that flag on ad-service is the least invasive allow-listed remediation; it requires human approval. If CPU and health do not recover, restart_workload is the next step.
